name: Coupang
thesis: High-scrutiny evaluation stance. Coupang holds leading market share in Korean e-commerce (Rocket Delivery flywheel), but recent operational and governance execution warrants extreme caution: (1) In November 2025, a rogue former employee triggered a massive customer account data incident ('the Incident'), resulting in US class actions and severe regulatory punishment. On June 10, 2026, the PIPC announced an administrative fine of ~$278M for the breach plus an unrelated ~$132M advertising fine, causing Coupang to accrue $410M in regulatory fines in Q2'26 and plunge into a -$556M GAAP operating loss; (2) Product Commerce active customers grew only +3% YoY to 24.7M in Q2'26 (and +2% in Q1'26), with management explicitly confirming that customer growth was impaired by the Incident, proving real churn and reputational backlash; (3) Regulatory headwinds remain acute: the KFTC is actively investigating and pushing to unbundle Coupang Eats from the WOW membership (hearing Sept 2026), threatening core subscriber economics; (4) Stock-based compensation remains high (~$600M-$650M annualized run-rate, $164M in Q2'26 alone); (5) Optical cheapness (~0.6x EV/Sales, $6.2B cash vs $3.0B equity) is tempered by ongoing regulatory, customer churn, and governance risks. High margin of safety required.
key_driver: Product Commerce active customer re-acceleration post-breach, resolution of KFTC WOW-bundling antitrust threats, and core operating leverage recovery ex-fines
